deflection_zh: 被欺負很難過，請馬上告訴爸爸媽媽或老師。

5-6: 先說：你說出來很勇敢，這不是你的錯
問清楚：是誰、在哪裡、發生什麼事
告訴孩子：被欺負時要找大人幫忙
和老師聯絡，一起想辦法保護孩子
7-8: 說明欺負別人的人，也可能需要幫助
教孩子說「我不喜歡這樣」，然後離開
紀錄事情的時間、地點與經過
和老師討論，不要只教孩子忍耐

what_not_to_say: 不要說「忍一忍就好」或「男生不要哭」
不要說「是不是你也有問題」

author: claude-haiku

en.deflection: I'm sorry you feel hurt. Please tell a grown-up right away, okay?
triggers: i don't want to go to school

5-6: Say: you were brave to tell me. This is not your fault.
Ask calmly: who was it, where was it, and what happened?
Tell your child to find a grown-up when someone is mean to them.
Contact the teacher and work together to keep your child safe.
7-8: Remember that children who bully others may also need help.
Teach your child to say 'I don't like that' and then walk away.
Write down the dates, places, and what happened.
Talk with the teacher; don't only teach your child to put up with it.

what_not_to_say: Don't say 'just bear it' or 'boys shouldn't cry'.
Don't tell your child to hit back.
Don't ask 'maybe you did something to cause it?'
